title: Rav Bivi bar Bizna
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In a gloss on the Rambam’s introduction to Zera’im and in Sefer Keritut, Leshon Limmudim, they wrote that where it says in Sanhedrin 17b “the Neharbelaim teach,” this is Rav Bivi bar Bizna. The text Hyman uses reads Rami bar Berabbi or Berukhi.

notes.text: The consulted Sanhedrin 17b reads Rami bar Berabbi. The identification with Rav Bivi and the Berukhi form are reported as Hyman gives them.
